public_rationale: OpenAI's figures are broadly corroborated. Anthropic's result depends on which financial measure 'lost' denotes: its filing distinguishes operating loss from a substantially larger net loss, while the post linked a cash-burn projection. Those measures cannot be substituted for one another. The bundled claim therefore cannot receive a clean financial verdict on a matched basis.
limitations: This does not mean that no 2024 financial results are available.
The numerical agreement for one accounting measure does not validate another.
OpenAI's completed-year figures were accessed through reporting, not the underlying statements.
